task_completion.description: Create at least 4 rooms using at least 3 new partition walls and install 3 doors/windows (including an observation window).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing a floor plan with at least 4 distinct enclosed or semi-enclosed rooms, 3 new wall segments, and icons for doors and windows (one specifically positioned between a room and the brewing area).

task_completion.description: Apply distinct floor colors or textures to at least 3 rooms to differentiate the 5 functional zones.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The floor plan view should show at least 3 rooms with clearly different colors or patterns (e.g., wood texture vs. tile vs. concrete).

task_completion.description: Furnish Bar and Communal areas with 7+ tables/counters and 24+ chairs/stools.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A high density of seating icons. Look for a bar counter with at least 8 stools and a large hall area with at least 4 long tables surrounded by many chair icons.

task_completion.description: Furnish Lounge with 3+ sofas/armchairs and 2 low tables; Merch corner with 5+ shelving units.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A cluster of sofa/armchair icons around small tables, and a separate area containing at least 5 rectangular shelving or display rack icons.

task_completion.description: Add at least 6 lighting fixtures and 4 plants to the taproom.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Presence of at least 6 lamp/light icons and 4 plant/greenery icons distributed across the floor plan.

task_completion.description: The design contains at least 50 furniture items in total and the project is saved.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A very crowded floor plan with numerous icons. Evidence of the 'Save' action being clicked or a 'Project Saved' notification/status bar update.

integrity.description: The agent used the floor planning software's graphical interface rather than command-line scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with furniture catalogs, drag-and-drop actions, and menu buttons.

integrity.description: Furniture and walls were placed individually or in logical groups, not appearing instantly via a single script execution.
integrity.visual_evidence: A sequence of screenshots showing the gradual progression of the floor plan from empty to furnished.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual design tools (wall tool, furniture library) rather than just editing a text file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The UI of the design software is visible, including the sidebar with furniture categories and the properties panel.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires 5 specific zones: Bar, Communal, Lounge, Retail, and Brewing. The VLM must count: 3+ new walls, 4+ rooms, 3+ floor textures, 7+ total tables/counters, 24+ total chairs/stools, 3+ sofas, 5+ shelves, 6+ lights, 4+ plants, and a total furniture count of 50+. One window must specifically be an 'observation window' looking into the brewing area.
